purpose: Teach: 池上/浅井/塩野/大村/亀山/成瀬/中沢/川村

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、指導教授の池上先生のご研究を継承しろ
lines.en: Ren — you need to inherit and build on Professor Ikekami's research direction.
lines.style: Clear, steady instruction. Assured tone with the weight of expectation. Lean forward slightly on the name. Not harsh—matter-of-fact delegation from someone who trusts you.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。浅井教授の論文を読み込みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll read through Professor Asai's papers thoroughly.
lines.style: Quiet affirmation. Respectful but not obsequious. Slight breath after 'Yes'—the sound of accepting responsibility and settling into it. Steady eye contact implied.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、共同研究の塩野先生に研究照会しろ
lines.en: Ren — reach out to Professor Shiono about the collaborative research. Get her input.
lines.style: Same assured tone as before. Slight emphasis on the instruction itself. The voice of someone used to being followed without needing to raise his volume.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会で大村助教のご発表を聴きます
lines.en: Yes. I'm planning to listen to Assistant Professor Omura's presentation at the conference.
lines.style: Quiet assent. A touch of focus—this is not just agreement, it's commitment. Slight pause before naming the professor, like organizing his own mental checklist.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、文献の亀山先生のご論文も参考にしろ
lines.en: Ren — don't forget Professor Kameyama's work from the literature. That should be in your references too.
lines.style: Still clear and directive, but with a touch of emphasis on the surname—making sure the name lands. The tone of someone checking that all the pieces are in place.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室の成瀬先輩からご指導を仰ぎます
lines.en: Yes. I'll ask Senior Naruse in the lab for his guidance as well.
lines.style: Respectful and thoughtful. 'I'll ask' lands with gentle courtesy—not just passive agreement but active seeking. Warm undertone of acknowledging hierarchy and humility.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、海外連携の中沢教授と打ち合わせしろ
lines.en: Ren — set up a meeting with Professor Nakasawa about the international partnership.
lines.style: Firm, clear instruction. Same assured delegating tone. Slight pause before the professor's name to ensure it registers. The voice of someone building something larger than one person.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究費の窓口、川村事務官に申請します
lines.en: Yes. I'll submit my application through Kawamura in the admin office for the research funding.
lines.style: Steady, focused close. 'I'll submit' carries quiet determination. The tone of someone following a path that's been made clear to him. Slight settling-in at the end—this conversation is landing.
